# Formbricks

Formbricks is an open-source platform for building and managing surveys, enabling organizations to collect and analyze user feedback effectively.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/formbricks/.

## Actions

- **Create Action Class**: Create a new action class.
- **Create Attribute Class**: Create an attribute class in Formbricks.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact.
- **Create Display**: Mark a survey as displayed or link it to a response.
- **Create Survey**: Create a new survey.
- **Create Survey Response**: Create a response for a survey.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook.
- **Delete Attribute Class**: Delete an attribute class.
- **Delete Person**: Delete a person.
- **Delete Survey**: Delete a survey by its ID.
- **Delete Survey Response**: Delete a survey response by its ID.
- **Delete Team**: Delete a team.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook by ID.
- **Get Account Info**: Retrieve account information.
- **Get All Contacts**: Retrieve all contacts within the organization.
- **Get Me**: Retrieve current authenticated organization's and environment details.
- **Get Responses**: Retrieve a list of survey responses.
- **Get Roles**: Retrieve all available roles in the system.
- **Get Users**: Retrieve a list of users within the environment using the Management API.
- **Get Webhook**: Retrieve details of a specific webhook.
- **List Action Classes**: List all action classes.
- **List Attribute Classes**: List all attribute classes.
- **List Surveys**: List all surveys.
- **List Webhooks**: List all webhooks.
- **Update Person**: Update an existing person.
- **Update Survey**: Update an existing survey.
- **Update Survey Response**: Update an existing survey response.
- **Update Webhook**: Update an existing webhook.
- **Upload Bulk Contacts**: Upload multiple contacts in bulk.
- **Upload Private File**: Obtain S3 presigned upload data for a private survey file.
- **Upload Public File**: Get S3 presigned data for uploading a public file.
